inputs.text: Hi, Mum. It's me. How are you feeling today?
Oh. I'm all right. A little tired, that's all. How are you?
I'm okay. Busy at work. Did you manage to call the doctor?
Yes, yesterday. They're going to call me back with an appointment.
Let me know when you hear. I'll see if I can come with you.
Listen, I'd better get back to work. Can I call you this evening?
All right. Speak tonight. Love you.
